sentences.text:
Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.5089 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.121 of 2023 of Cyber Crimes (DD) Police Station, Hyderabad District, against the petitioner-accused No.1.
2.

entities.text: Cyber Crimes (DD) Police Station, Hyderabad District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.1 in Crime No.121 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 66-C and 66-D of Information Technology Act, 2000.

3. Heard Ms.Sandhra Rani Racharla, learned counsel representing Mr.Nageshwar Rao Pujari,
learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner is determined to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment of less than seven years, the Police concerned have not issued any notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023, as such, the petitioner is apprehending coercive measures against him.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is ready to cooperate with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue 35 (3)
of BNSS, 2023 notice and as per his instructions, the petitioner is not available for personal service and he may directed to cooperate with the investigation.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment below seven years and as the petitioner is ready to engage himself in the process, without going into merits of the matter, the petitioner is directed to appear before the SHO, Cyber Crimes (DD), Hyderabad District, on or before 17.04.2025, whereupon, the Investigating Officer shall issue notice on the petitioner under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 in Crime No.121 of 2023 and take up further proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.
